sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:14

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:14:1
items.html: Each one divides into four, etc., and each of these is included of ten: The division into four is according to the four discernments of coarseness in the screen, since each of the four discernments brings out a level of ten Sefirot, as is known. Thus the four discernments comprise forty Sefirot. And each and every one of the eight kings is included of these forty Sefirot; hence there are 320 discernments in them. And here one must understand why he does not count five discernments in the screen, since there are five discernments of coarseness in the screen. Rather, the matter is that phase four is not present here, for after it disappeared through the refinement of the Guf [body] of the Keter of AK, it was never renewed again; and there is nothing here in Nekudim but phase four of clothing, with no coarseness at all. Hence there are only four discernments of coarseness here. And this is what alludes to the secret of the four letters of the name HaVaYaH — for even in HaVaYaH there is no level of Keter in them, but only by the hint of the tip of the Yod, as is known, which is likewise for the reason stated.
